stem: During follow-up for food protein-induced enterocolitis syndrome, which trigger group tends to improve earliest?
explanation: Rice and grain FPIES improve earliest. This is the trigger group most likely to resolve sooner than other common FPIES triggers.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because cow's milk and soy are not identified as the earliest-improving FPIES triggers.
optionExplanations.B: Correct because rice and grain FPIES are noted to improve earliest.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because peanut is not identified as the earliest-improving trigger group.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because fish is not identified as the earliest-improving trigger group.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because egg is not identified as the earliest-improving trigger group.
